Class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<T>>

java.lang.Object
com.marcelo.backend.bst.BinarySearchTree<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of data stored in the tree, which must be comparable.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tree<T>, Subject
public class BinarySearchTree<T extends Comparable<T>> extends Object implements Tree<T>, Subject
A generic implementation of a Binary Search Tree.
